name: ExtendScript ES3 Guard
description: When a JSX file is saved, verify it only uses ECMAScript 3 syntax compatible with After Effects ExtendScript.

actions.prompt:
The file {{filePath}} was just saved. This is an ExtendScript file that must use ECMAScript 3 ONLY. Check for any ES5+ syntax violations:
- const or let (must use var)
- Arrow functions (must use function expressions)
- Template literals (must use string concatenation)
- Classes (must use constructor functions)
- Destructuring (must use individual assignments)
- for...of loops (must use for or for-in)
- Spread/rest operators
- Default parameters
- Getter/setter literals

Also verify:
- Every function that modifies the project wraps changes in app.beginUndoGroup()/app.endUndoGroup()
- app.endUndoGroup() is called on EVERY return path (including error paths)
- No user strings are interpolated into eval() — they must go through decodeBridge()
- Return values follow the convention: 'true' for silent success, 'OK:message' for success with message, any other string for error

List any violations with line numbers.
